It looks like all is lost until a mysterious stranger steps in to save the battle and the day. But the Saint Shields vow to return and fulfill their mission to capture and seal the four Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson and Max's Mom show up at Tyson's dojo empty-handed. Dr. Zagart and the mysterious rock have vanished without a trace. Knowing Dr. Zagart is the key to finding the missing rock, the BladeBreakers decide to launch their own search. One problem, they have no idea where to start looking. Meanwhile Dr. Zagart and Dr. K have designed a new powerful Blade using the rock, and they've chosen a Blader named Foxy to challenge our heroes. While Tyson is busy with Zeo, the boy he met the day before when he fought Ozuma, Foxy attacks. Never one to turn down a challenge Ray follows Foxy into the woods. Foxy's rock powered Blade nearly destroys Ray's Blade but Tyson shows up in the nick of time and coaches Ray to victory. The BladeBreakers congratulate Ray on his victory but the Saint Shields also witnessed the battle. Intrigued, Ozuma vows more than ever to get the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In the quiet after Foxy's storm, the BladeBreakers try to figure out who or what was behind his attack, and how it all tied into the mysterious Rock. Meanwhile, Tyson reaches a breaking point, discouraged and upset by the constant attempts of fanatic groups trying to steal the sacred bit-beasts. His anxiety goes overboard when he coaxes Kenny to create a wacky training platform for the team to practice with. He takes his jaded attitude out on Zeo, who simply wants to spar with one of the greats. At the same time, The Saint Shields' frustration level also grows, as Ozuma decides that the Bladebreakers are unworthy of possessing the sacred bit-beasts any longer. Tyson remembers the simple joys of Beyblading when he finally agrees to train with Zeo and coaches him so he can pass his Beyblading exam. The proud feeling that Tyson gets may just be enough to get him and his team through these tough times'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson deciphers the words that are carved onto the mysterious rocks and reads the kids this warning; 'Dare not disturb this stone, for here, the Bit Beasts are sealed.' The kids realize that the Saint Shields are part of a clan which still uses this ancient language and they resolve to confront them, even if it means battling and losing their Beyblades in the bargain. Ozuma reveals the history of the Bit Beasts to the Bladebreakers, telling of them of their origin as benevolent spirits until evil men discovered how to control them and use them for their own malicious needs. Since that time, the clan of the Saint Shields has made it their mission to seal the Bit Beasts and save the world from destruction. Dunga issues a battle challenge to the Bladebreakers and Ray answers it with confidence, but Dunga's new Vortex Ape proves too much for Driger. After Ray's Bit Beast is taken, the team goes into training but will they be able to save Driger without putting themselves into further jeopardy?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Doctor K has extracted a Spider Bit Beast from the rock and gives it to a new Blader named Net whose mission is to go out and capture Tyson's Dragoon. As Tyson races to a Junior Beyblade Tournament, Net cuts him off and draws him into battle. During the fight, Net keeps telling Tyson to release his Dragoon so he can steal it, but when Tyson finally does, Dragoon wins and Net runs away crying. In the end, Zeo absorbs the lesson taught to him by the BladeBreakers who invite him to train with them."

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is busy practicing his Beyblade skills alone in the park when out of nowhere a gust of wind appears and starts slicing everything to pieces. It turns out that it's the work of Jack, one of Dr. K's Blader's, and he's got a Bit Beast that harnesses the wind. Once the BladeBreakers figure this out, Ray volunteers to fight, but Kai stops him and sneaks out in the middle of the night to battle Jack. Discovering Kai is gone, the gang runs and finds him just as he's about to begin the battle. The gang realizes Kai doesn't stand a chance against this wind Bit Beast because he can't see it. Reluctantly they let Kai fight. An intense battle ensues and Kai takes a severe beating as he waits to catch a glimpse of Jack's Bit Beast. Finally Kai summons Dranzer and spots the wind Bit Beast and defeats it. Defeated, Jack runs off while Kai leaves the rest of BladeBreakers in awe as he walks off into the night.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Goaded by Dunga, Mariam goes off to capture Max's Draciel and finds him battling Dennis and his Bit Beast, Tyranno. Using his new Bit Finder Kenny measures Tyranno's impressive strength and is surprised when Dennis backs out of the battle before using its full power. Unaware that Mariam is following him, Max runs off in pursuit of Dennis and finds himself deep in the bowels of a mysterious building. He is ambushed by Dennis- who is now backed up by Dr. K and her Technicians. Mariam lies in wait, planning on taking Draciel once Tyranno weakens him. But when she discovers that Dr. K is using Power Injection to make Tyranno even stronger, Mariam launches Sharkrash and destroys the machinery and much of the building with it. It is now up to Max and Mariam to work together to find a way out of the crumbling building. But will Mariam capture Draciel once they escape?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fed up with all the recent attempts by Zagart and others to acquire the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts for sinister purposes, The Saint Shields decide to take action. Having already acquired Ray's Bit-Beast Driger in an earlier match, the Saint Shields confront our heroes again. They challenge the BladeBreakers to a match at an abandoned amusement park. The BladeBreakers know that if they lose, The Saint Shields will seal their Bit Beasts away forever in a mysterious rock to prevent them from being used for evil.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: But just when things start to heat up, Ray launches his blade to try to even the score. As the battle rages, the roller coaster collapses around all the blades and it appears our heroes are done for, especially since Ray is fighting without his Driger! But Ray is determined not to lose again and using his amazing powers of concentration, he's able to release his Bit Beast from the rock and with it, Ray and Kai defeat their opponents. The battle ends in victory just as Ozuma, who is furious, steps up and warns Tyson his Dragoon will be the next to be sealed!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Ozuma, leader of the Saint Shields gang makes a final play for the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts. During his battle with Tyson, it is revealed that he comes from an ancient group that is sworn to capture and contain all the Bit Beasts in the world. Thus protecting them from falling into the wrong hands and being used for evil purposes. However, once the battle heats up Ozuma's jealousy of Tyson's Beyblading skill takes him over. Pulling out all the stops, he forces Tyson to decide to give up the battle and surrender his Bit Beast or have his Blade destroyed. In a quiet moment of reflection, Tyson communicates with Dragoon and they decide to fight the good fight no matter what the result. Tyson and Dragoon lock horns with Ozuma's Bit Beast and weave a path of destruction on the playing field. When the dust settles the match is declared a tie and Ozuma realizes that Tyson and the BladeBreakers are worthy enough to look after the four Bit Beasts on their own. The Saint Shields say their goodbyes and walk away content that the four Bit Beasts are in good hands!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Pleased that the Saint Shields no longer wish to seal the four Bit Beasts, Dr. K gives a new Blader, Denny, a powerful rock Bit Beast named Clarken and orders him to capture the four Sacred Bit Beasts. Meanwhile, Zeo catches up with the Bladebreakers and shows them his invitation to the upcoming World Championships.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BladeBreakers show up at the World Championship Tournament and go up into the stands to cheer on Zeo who's fighting in the preliminaries. Tyson is pumped watching his new friend who wins his first fight with ease. Later backstage, Tyson tells Zeo he's totally impressed and asks if Zeo would like to become his training partner. Zeo excitedly agrees. Meanwhile back at Zagart's lab, Doctor K is on the verge of removing the strongest Bit Beast in the world from the rock. But just before she can finish, Zagart enters and terminates her on the spot. That night at Zeo's house, his dad returns from work. The shocker here is, guess who his dad is? That's right, Zagart!! And what's worse, an angry Doctor K shows up to confront her former boss in his house and as she does, Zeo overhears the entire conversation. Now Zeo realizes it's his dad who's been after the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts and his world is thrown into chaos!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Zeo focuses on Beyblade training with his father Zagart. The most powerful rock Bit-Beast named Cerberus is designated for Zeo, but he must first be able to summon it. Zeo trains furiously, but the elusive Bit Beast never fully materializes. Meanwhile, the Bladebreakers must choose their two team-pairs for the World Beyblade Championships. Hilary brings in a pile of her fortune-telling books to help. They decide that Tyson will team with Max, and Kai with Ray. Not long afterward, Kai meets a strange pair named King and Queen, who are very impressed by Dranzer. They talk Kai into battling them, with Dranzer's attack ring up for grabs if they win. To Kai's surprise, not only do they have Bit Beasts of their own, but they're not above tag-teaming him to avoid defeat. By the end of the battle, Dranzer is so damaged that its attack ring is useless, which sends King and Queen on their way empty-handed. When Kai discusses the incident with his BladeBreaker teammates, it's discovered that King and Queen are infamous 'parts hunters' - Blader's who search for high-end Beyblade parts from others that they can acquire for themselves. Back at Zagart's lab, Zeo tries summoning Cerberus one last time ' and succeeds. Cerberus is a massively powerful canine Bit Beast with three snarling heads. Zeo can't wait to use it against the Bladebreakers to acquire their Bit Beasts, which are necessary to fulfill his mysterious and still-unrevealed destiny.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: While all that the Bladebreakers can think of are the finals, Kai can't stop obsessing about King and Queen. With a brand new Beyblade crafted for him by Max, Kai longs for a rematch. But Kai isn't the only one with the royal pair on his mind. Doctor K tracks the duo down and offers them a chance to team up with her so they can capture and wield the power of the four sacred Bit Beasts together. The pair blow her off, interested only in their quests for stealing the perfect Beyblade parts. That is, until they meet up with Kai once more. In a coincidental encounter, Kai gets his wish for revenge. But before he tastes victory, the two disappear! Who knows where they'll turn up again but chances are good, Doctor K. won't be too far behind'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After disappearing thirty years ago, Zagart confronts Mr. Dickenson, forcing him to enter Zeo in the World Championship Finals. He reveals that Zeo is his son and that he won't show mercy when he confronts the Bladebreakers in the tournament. The Bladebreakers try to attend Zeo's match so they can find out what's happened to him but arrive at the arena too late. Meanwhile, Dr. K works with King and Queen to improve their powers so they can get the four sacred Bit Beasts for her. At the opening night gala, the final pairings are announced but tensions reach a boiling point when King and Queen start a no-rules Beyblade match with Dunga. The Bladebreakers manage to stop the duel, but the damage has already been done. The Beyblade finals will be a far more dangerous affair than last year. A grim Zeo looks down on the other finalists determined to win at all costs.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade World Championship Finals are underway and eight teams convene to compete for the title. The BladeBreakers are shocked to see that their old friend Zeo is in the competition and Tyson confronts him to find out why he has decided to compete against them. It turns out that Zeo is the son of Zagart, an old colleague of Mr. Dickenson's who stole the ancient rock that contained captured Bit Beasts. Zagart has already made it known to the BladeBreakers that he wants their Bit Beasts and he's going to use Zeo to get them. Once the competition begins, Zeo's team member Gordo makes short work of Dunga. Then it's Zeo turn. He goes up against Ozuma and it is clear to everyone watching that Zeo's Blade is no ordinary Beyblade. After a very intense battle Zeo defeats Ozuma surprising the entire audience and putting him in a position to move on to the next round where his team will battle the BladeBreakers!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Beyblade Championships continue and the next round has Tyson and Max squaring off against Kane and Jim. Kane and Jim decide to have a little practice battle at the beach. But King and Queen show up and in a surprise attack, they jump into battle and literally destroy Kane and Jim's Beyblades, forcing them to withdraw from the tournament. So the next battle up is King and Queen facing Mariam and Joseph from the Saint Shields. Mariam and Queen launch first, and as they battle, King suddenly launches his blades making it two against one which is totally illegal! The officials are about to call off the fight when Joseph tells them not to and he joins in the fray! In the end, King and Queen combine forces and first attack Mariam and then they team up on Joseph. The battle is over, the crowd is stunned as King and Queen eliminate Mariam and Joseph from the tournament and it looks like the next targets of King and Queen are Max and Tyson!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In the Semi-Final round of the World Beyblade Championships, Max & Tyson take on King & Queen. Doctor K tempts Queen into using a vicious new attack ring she's created called 'The Shredder'. Queen uses it against Max, and nearly grinds Draciel into a pulp. But with Max using the new Draciel V2 Judy gave him, and having the will of the crowd and his teammates behind him, Max overcomes this attack, destroys Queen's Beyblade, and wins the first match of the best-of-two. Next up, is King versus Tyson, who has an improved Beyblade of his own, thanks to Kenny's ingenuity. Angered by the failure of Doctor K's attack ring, King dissolves his partnership with the scientist and vows to combat Tyson without her assistance. The resulting match is an intense, high-powered battle that's not only fair, but completely up for grabs. When Tyson's blade begins faltering for some unknown reason, the combatants spot Doctor K high above the stadium. Through a rooftop window, she's using a particle beam to try and disable Dragoon. Disgusted by her attempt to throw the match, King and Tyson put aside their differences, combine their Bit Beast attack, and destroy her weapon. With the playing field even again, the Blader's resume their match and Tyson wins. King's display of honesty generates a newfound respect for King and Queen from the Bladebreakers.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The second semi-final round begins pitting Kai and Ray against the surprising Zeo and Gordo. Ray faces Gordo first and attacks fiercely but Orthrus always seems to evade Driger's attacks. Zagart has programmed all of the Bladebreakers moves into Zeo and Gordo's Beyblades, making them unbeatable. Soon, Driger is almost out of power and Gordo seizes his chance. But when Kai reminds Ray of the pain he felt losing Driger to Dunga, Ray taps into his Beyblade spirit and helps Driger salvage a tie. Victory now rests on Kai's shoulders. Kai and Zeo begin an awesome duel, unleashing so much energy that the stadium begins to break apart. The duel becomes a question of whose endurance is greater. As the effects of one final, powerful blast subside, Kai falls to Zeo, who hasn't even broken a sweat!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The stress of competing in the World Beyblade Championships has begun to fracture the BladeBreakers. Kai loses his match and his Bit Beast Dranzer to Zeo. This makes Zeo even more powerful and puts the rest of BladeBreakers on edge. Tyson takes it hardest of all, and when he confronts his old friend he gets an earful on what it takes to be a real Beyblading champion. 'A true Beyblade Champion fights alone and doesn't need a team or friends to win!' Tyson takes this message to heart and decides to turn his back on his teammates. Meanwhile Kai, racked with guilt over the loss of Dranzer, decides to quit Beyblading for good! Beystadium where he will fight the final match of the Beyblade World Championships. He has a vision, he sees his friends and teammates and begins to realize what they mean to him. Suddenly Kai appears and forces Tyson into a Beyblade battle hoping that he will stop doubting himself and focus on his important match with Zeo. The rest of the BladeBreakers show up and witness the awesome battle. Tyson realizes that with his friends by his side he can, no, he will, win the championship title again! Let it rip!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Championship Finals begin as Tyson faces Gordo. Despite Orthrus' increased size and power, Tyson and Dragoon emerge victorious due to their spiritual link. Meanwhile Kenny and Mr. Dickenson confront Zagart with their suspicions about Zeo. Zagart listens to their pleas but refuses to pull Zeo from the match despite the strain it's putting on his body. Zeo is battling for himself now. Determined to win back Dranzer for Kai, Max battles with an intensity he's never had before and pushes Zeo to the brink of defeat. But Zeo summons a Super Bit Beast that combines the powers of Cerberus and Dranzer and overwhelms Draciel. The final victory comes down to a tie-breaking match between Zeo and Tyson. As the match begins, Zeo's body begins to break down revealing his secret to the entire world.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days; featuring: Motörhead.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Hall & Oates - Live at The Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: Daryl Hall and John Oates wisely reunited a few years ago after a string of solo projects, & they put on the kind of show that makes it hard to believe they even considered going their separate ways. Here they are at the Sydney Entertainment Centre.

programme.title: The Clash - Rebel Truce: The history of The Clash
programme.desc: The Clash were one of the most influential bands to blow up from the Punk rock scene of 1977, with the late Joe Strummer revered as one of the greatest frontmen in rock'n'Roll music history.

programme.title: Tom Odell - Live at Irving Plaza
programme.desc: Having already conquered the UK with his chart-topping debut album 'Long Way Down', don't miss Tom Odell's dazzling live show filmed at Irving Plaza, New York City. Watch the 22-year-old English wunderkind deliver stirring hits like 'Another Love'.

programme.title: John Legend - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007. Featuring: John Legend.

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Seal's one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. He's delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career.

programme.title: Usher - Omg Tour (Live from London)
programme.desc: Treating the crowd at London's O2 Arena to his signature brand of R&B infused pop, Usher performed hits from recent albums Versus and Raymond V. Raymond, including DJ Got Us Falling in Love, There Goes My Baby, and OMG.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - The Space Within US
programme.desc: Paul McCartney presents this special performance of the US Tour, made in the United States, 11 weeks and 34 shows, playing great compositions of his solo career along with some Wings and Beatles songs.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, New Blood - Live In London captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra.

programme.title: Coldplay - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux
programme.desc: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux and this concert from 2013 is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies through their eighties blockbuster period and up to their most recent release. Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Rush - Time Machine: Live in Cleveland
programme.desc: Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures,' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centerpiece of the concerts.

programme.title: Rod Stewart - Live at Hyde Park
programme.desc: Experience the legendary Rod Stewart as he closes Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day with a memorable performance in September 2015 at London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: Justin Timberlake -- Live From New York
programme.desc: The "FutureSex/LoveSounds" album is one of the most awarded 2007 albums and has sold more than eight million copies worldwide.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Duran Duran - Live from London
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular live experience from start to finish; classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable versions of their hits: Rio, Hungry Like The Wolf, The Reflex and many more.

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Adele - iTunes Festival: Live in London
Britney Spears - Live from London
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Britney Spears performs her hits including Baby One More Time, Oops! I Did It Again, Toxic and many more.

programme.title: Diana Krall - Live In Rio
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long-time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This stunning concert is filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008.

programme.title: John Legend - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007. Featuring: John Legend.

programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks.

programme.title: Hans Zimmer - Live in Prague
programme.desc: This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr.

programme.title: 3 Excavators Loading Overburden + Cat 160H Grader in Huge Mine

programme.title: Relocating The Caterpillar D9T Dozer, Liebherr 974 & Liebherr 954

programme.title: Mining Site Full Of Caterpillar & Liebherr Excavators And Fleet Of Trucks

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Cat 777F Dumpers With Aggregates
programme.desc: In today’s video, we’re inside a huge aggregate quarry, watching an impressive, high-production operation where a Caterpillar 992K wheel loader loads blasted material onto Caterpillar 777F dumpers with speed, precision, and nonstop rhythm.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, "Little Russian."

programme.title: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Fifth Symphony; Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt's First Piano Concerto.

programme.title: Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works.

programme.title: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programme.desc: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the development of music TV over the last 50 years and its power in popularizing the classical genre.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programme.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: In this August 2020 concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra; Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy-winning producer and artist Hit-Boy joins Joel Madden to discuss legacy, therapy, fatherhood, and reclaiming his power after years producing for Jay-Z, Nas, and Travis Scott.

programme.title: I Go To The Rock: The Gospel of Whitney Houston
programme.desc: Whitney Houston's voice is powerful and timeless. Her heart was always in Gospel music. From her first performance to the best-selling Gospel album, The Preacher's Wife.

programme.title: Get Thrashed: Around the World (Bonus Interviews on Thrash Metal)
programme.desc: Bonus footage from Get Thrashed featuring global thrash scenes—from Germany to Brazil—with members of Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus sharing deep-cut bands and era highlights.

programme.title: Fall Out Boy: So Much For (2our) Dust Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: Recorded at the iconic Madison Square Garden, So Much For (2our) Dust captures Fall Out Boy delivering an electrifying performance filled with emotion, energy, and nostalgia. With a setlist that spans their entire career — from early emo anthems to their latest hits — the band’s signature blend of heartfelt lyrics and explosive showmanship takes center stage. Between songs, frontman Pete Wentz shares raw reflections on loss, creativity, and the band’s improbable journey from punk clubs to arena stardom, making this concert a powerful chronicle of endurance and connection.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel speaks with Bebe Rexha about her start in music, self-regulation, mental health, and her album Dirty Blonde.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Taylor Goldsmith, frontman of the acclaimed band Dawes, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation about balancing happiness with ambition, the search for meaning in success, and the band’s latest album, Oh Brother. Goldsmith reflects on songwriting, self-growth, and the wisdom learned through years of making music.

programme.title: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses perform a co-headlining concert live from The Wiltern in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Rascal Flatts: Life Is a Highway Tour: Live from Columbus
programme.desc: Country superstars Rascal Flatts celebrate 25 years of music with a hometown performance in Columbus, Ohio, recorded on their Life Is a Highway Tour. The set features timeless hits like Bless the Broken Road, What Hurts the Most, Mayberry, Fast Cars and Freedom, and Life Is a Highway. It’s an evening filled with nostalgia, gratitude, and classic country harmony.

programme.title: Anthony Green: So Long, Avalon Live In New York
programme.desc: Experience Anthony Green live from the Gramercy Theatre in New York as he celebrates the release of So Long, Avalon. An intimate, high–energy set blends new material with fan favorites, spontaneous crowd moments, and a playful nod to classic “Kokomo.” Green spotlights his touring band — Greg Mervine (drums), Sean Cohen (multi-instrumentalist), Dave Davison, and Keith Goodwin — and shouts out friends Kurt Travis and Geoff Rickly for helping shape a special night. A dynamic performance that captures Green’s voice, humor, and gratitude in a room full of true believers.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Michael Clifford, guitarist and songwriter of 5 Seconds of Summer, joins Joel Madden to talk about fatherhood, the meaning of maturity, and rediscovering the joy of music through his solo debut Side Quest. Clifford reflects on how parenthood reshaped his creativity, working with bandmate Calum Hood, and learning to write from a more grounded, human perspective.

programme.title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
programme.desc: Jay Pharoah delivers a stand-up special packed with celebrity impressions and sharp humor, featuring takes on icons like Jay-Z, Barack Obama, and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Italian singer, songwriter, and frontman of Måneskin, Damiano David joins Joel Madden to discuss pursuing happiness through creativity, missing home while touring, and his upcoming solo project. He reflects on defining authenticity in pop and rock, staying grounded through fame, and the evolving relationship between art, purpose, and balance.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Producer/guitarist Josh Carter—one half of genre-bending duo Phantogram—joins host Joel Madden to talk about why trying too hard can kill the art, his creative/lifelong bond with bandmate Sarah Barthel, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. From upstate New York origins to Brooklyn and now L.A., Josh digs into collaboration culture, beat-making roots, Big Grams with Big Boi, and the hip-hop influences (Beastie Boys, Wu-Tang, Public Enemy) that shaped his sound—plus a little baseball talk (Mets, Dodgers, Orioles).

programme.title: 311 Day 2024 Live from Las Vegas: Night 2
programme.desc: 311 returns for Night 2 of their 311 Day celebration with a unique 2+ hour set of fan favorites and surprises live from Park MGM in Las Vegas.

programme.title: a-ha: True North
programme.desc: 90km above the Arctic Circle, Norway's very own a-ha recorded their first collection of music since 2015's Cast in Steel. "True North is a letter from a-ha, from the Arctic Circle, a poem from the far north of Norway," says Magne Furuholmen. Accompanied by a film, the conceptual collection combines the band's visions and the talent of Norwegian orchestra, Arctic Philharmonic.

programme.title: AJ Rafael: Take Me Back Tour From Gramercy Theatre
programme.desc: Experience AJ Rafael’s heartfelt “Take Me Back Tour” live from New York City’s Gramercy Theatre. Blending nostalgia and artistry, AJ performs fan favorites and new tracks including “Take Me Back,” “Showstopper,” and “I Just Want You.” Through soulful storytelling, intimate moments, and emotional performances, AJ reflects on his journey from the early Myspace and YouTube days to becoming one of the most beloved independent singer-songwriters of his generation.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Morgan Lander, frontwoman of Canadian heavy metal band Kittie, joins Joel Madden to discuss breaking into the metal scene as teenage girls, reclaiming power in a male-dominated industry, and redefining success on their own terms. Lander reflects on burnout, body autonomy, and growing up in the spotlight before returning stronger than ever.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Warren Zeiders to discuss his unexpected rise from aspiring lacrosse player to country star. Warren reflects on viral success, hit songs like “Pretty Little Poison,” the pressure of following a breakout year, separating self-worth from streaming numbers, and why his new album No Brakes is his most honest work yet.

programme.title: Nobody's Gonna Do It For You: Ten Years of Sincere Engineer
programme.desc: Sincere Engineer reflects on ten years of wild journey, recognizing the village that helped raise it and thanking fans and friends.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jon Foreman, frontman of the GRAMMY-winning rock band Switchfoot, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation on surfing, faith, creativity, and the balance between joy and discomfort. They explore themes of mindfulness, artistic purpose, and growth through challenge — diving into Jon’s new solo album In Bloom and the philosophies that guide both his music and his life.

programme.title: Foxing: Live at The Grandel
programme.desc: Foxing performs Draw Down The Moon in full, captured live at The Grandel in St. Louis for a concert film experience.

programme.title: Billy Idol: State Line Live at the Hoover Dam
programme.desc: Punk icon Billy Idol makes history with the first-ever concert at the Hoover Dam, performing alongside longtime collaborator Steve Stevens and his band. This landmark event blends raw rock energy with stunning desert visuals and intimate acoustic moments. Featuring special guests Alison Mosshart (The Kills), Steve Jones (Sex Pistols), and Tony Kanal (No Doubt.

programme.title: Coldplay: Music of the Spheres Live at River Plate
programme.desc: Filmed during Coldplay’s record-breaking ten-night run at Buenos Aires’ River Plate Stadium, Music of the Spheres: Live at River Plate captures one of the most visually and sonically ambitious tours ever staged. With hits like “Higher Power,” “Viva La Vida,” “The Scientist,” and “Yellow,” the film showcases the band’s signature mix of immersive visuals, global unity, and emotional performance. Led by Chris Martin, Coldplay transforms the stadium into a kaleidoscopic celebration of love, connection, and hope, featuring surprise collaborations and multilingual crowd moments broadcast to fans worldwide.

programme.title: Poppy: Live at House of Blues in Anaheim
programme.desc: Poppy performs live at House of Blues Anaheim on the second leg of her “They’re All Around Us” Tour. This concert capture features dark, industrial-tinged themes and high-intensity vocals.

programme.title: Comedian CP: Sunday After Six
programme.desc: Known for his sharp wit and fearless storytelling, Comedian CP (Detroiters, Love Life, How to Die Alone) takes the stage in Sunday After Six — a no-holds-barred stand-up special that dives into fatherhood, relationships, race, and the kind of real-life moments you couldn’t make up. From awkward encounters to wild imagination, CP’s offbeat humor and unfiltered honesty make every punchline land harder than the last.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with comedian and host Jessi Cruickshank for a fast, funny conversation about boy-band fandom, parenting twins (and a third kid), and finding sanity on tour. They swap stories on public-parent life, the joys and chaos of twinhood, and how identity, confidence, and career evolve with family.

programme.title: Letlive: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Experience Letlive performing at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Celebrate the music and the city that shaped it.

programme.title: Melissa Villaseñor: Welp... What Now?
programme.desc: In her debut stand-up special, SNL alum Melissa Villaseñor reflects on her six seasons at Saturday Night Live, life after fame, and finding herself through humor, music, and culture. Recorded live at the historic Bob Baker Marionette Theater in Highland Park, Los Angeles, with musical guests Wolves of Glendale.

programme.title: DEVO: 50 Years of De-Evolution…Live!
programme.desc: DEVO performs at Denver’s Mission Ballroom, blending art, technology, and attitude in a high-energy live show.

programme.title: Chase Atlantic: LOST IN HEAVEN
programme.desc: Chase Atlantic's LOST IN HEAVEN is a feature-length concert film capturing their final night at London’s O2 Arena.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Carmen Christopher: Live from the Windy City
programme.desc: Comedian Carmen Christopher returns home to Chicago for a sharp, surreal, and hilarious stand-up special that blends the absurd with the heartfelt. With quick wit and offbeat honesty, Christopher riffs on social media, family, dating, politics, and Midwest life in a performance that’s both painfully self-aware and laugh-out-loud ridiculous. Executive produced by Tim Robinson and Zach Kanin.

programme.title: Phantogram: 'Running Through Colors' Tour Live in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Phantogram performs a sold-out show at the Hollywood Palladium, delivering a dynamic live set from their Running Through Colors tour.

programme.title: NEW KPOP Choice
programme.desc: Dive into the "Dark Stage Compilation", a playlist filled with powerful and intense tales of love and passion. This collection brings together tracks that capture the essence of deep, dark romance through their compelling rhythms and atmospheric melodies. Each song tells a story of love that is both fierce and mysterious, perfect for creating an atmosphere of intense emotion.(Track List: MONSTA X - DRAMARAMA / MONSTA X - Love Killa / (G)I-DLE - Luv U / (G)I-DLE - OH MY GOD / ENHYPEN - Drunk-Dazed / ENHYPEN - FEVER / SUNMI - Siren / Moon Byul - Eclipse / SF9 - Now or Never / SF9 - Tear Drop / VIVIZ - PULL UP / VIVIZ - MANIAC / THE BOYZ - REVEAL / THE BOYZ - The Stealer / Red Velvet - Bad Boy / Dreamcatcher - Deja Vu / TAEMIN - WANT / YUJU - Play / RYU SU JEONG - Tiger Eyes / SEVENTEEN - Getting Closer / NCT U - BOSS / CLASS:y - Tick Tick Boom / ASTRO - Blue Flame / BOYNEXTDOOR - But Sometimes / ITZY - In the morning)

programme.title: NEW KPOP Choice
programme.desc: Explore the vibrant world of K-pop beyond the hits with "Essential K-pop B-Side Tracks". programme.title: RAILROAD TIGERS [English Dub]
programme.desc: A railroad worker in China in 1941 leads a team of freedom fighters against the Japanese in order to get food for the poor.

programme.title: Scandal Makers [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Nam Hyun-soo, a former teen star, is now the host of a popular radio show. But one day a very young single mom named Jung-nam sends her stories to Hyun-soo’s show. Her stories about her longing to meet her father whom she’s never seen before grips the nation and catapults the ratings. But Jung-nam and her son invade Hyun-soo’s home and his radio station, claiming that Hyun-soo is her father.

programme.title: TAI CHI ZERO [English Dub]
programme.desc: Yang travels to Chen Village to learn a powerful form of Tai Chi. Though villagers are forbidden from teaching outsiders, Yang becomes their best hope for survival when a man arrives with a plan to build a railroad through the village.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tai Chi Hero is a martial arts adventure story about a martial artist defending his adopted home and marriage while mastering the art of Tai Chi. Starring Jayden Yuan, Angelababy, Eddie Peng. Continuing his journey, Yang Lu Chan marries into the Chen family to learn advanced Tai Chi. Soon, he must overcome internal village suspicion and lead the defense against a powerful army armed with deadly western technology.

programme.title: SWORD MASTER [English Dub]
programme.desc: Sword Master is a martial arts action story about an elite swordsman who fakes his death to escape violence, only to be dragged back by his past. Starring Lin Gengxin, Peter Ho, Jiang Yiyan. Exhausted by endless bloodshed, a legendary master fakes his death to live in anonymity.

programme.title: CALL OF HEROES [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A group of villagers must stand up to a warlord's psychopath son, who is protected by a Commander with proficient martial arts skills as well as a small army.

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: BADGES OF FURY [English Dub]
programme.desc: In just 3 days, three cases of Smiling Murder shock Hong Kong. The young detective Wang Bu'er and his buddy Huang Feihong embark on an investigation full of excitement and unexpected events.

programme.title: CRAZY FIST [English Dub]
programme.desc: A mixed martial arts champion is forced out of retirement for one last fight in order to unravel a major conspiracy.

programme.title: BLAZING FISTS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ikuto and Ryoma meet in juvenile detention and become best friends, they pursue their dream of participating in the martial arts event Breaking Down. However, rivalries soon turn their dreams into unexpected conflicts.

programme.title: Shadow [English Dub]
programme.desc: In a kingdom ruled by a young and unpredictable king, the military commander has a secret weapon: a shadow, a look-alike who can fool both his enemies and the King himself. Now he must use this weapon in an intricate plan that will lead his people to victory in a war that the King does not want.

programme.title: THE ASSASSINS [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the year 198, Cao Cao, Prime Minister of the Han Dynasty, ventured to the east and defeated China's greatest warrior Lu Bu, terrifying every ambitious warlord across the country. Several years later, after taking the Han Emperor under his wing, Cao crowns himself King of Wei. He built a magnificent Bronze Sparrow Island to symbolize his power and rumors spread that he would replace the Emperor. Meanwhile, young lovers Mu Shun and Ling Ju are taken from a prison camp to a hidden tomb, where they spend five cruel years together, training as assassins for a secret mission. In the year 220 astronomical signs predict dramatic change. As a result, Cao's son Cao Pi and Cao's followers urge Cao to become the new Emperor - but unknown opposing forces plot against him.

programme.title: MEMORIES OF THE SWORD [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: While in medieval Korea, a young girl sets out to revenge the betrayal and the death of her mother. But therefore she must face one of the most powerful men and warriors of the Goryo Dynasty.

programme.title: YOUNG DETECTIVE DEE: RISE OF THE SEA DRAGON [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Young Detective Dee: Rise of the Sea Dragon is a mystery action story about a brilliant young investigator uncovering a treacherous political plot involving a terrifying sea monster. Starring Mark Chao, Feng Shaofeng, Angelababy. Newly arrived in Luoyang, Dee Renjie investigates a sudden monster attack that destroyed the imperial fleet. Teaming up with hostile rival officers, he uncovers a deadly treasonous plot threatening the highest reaches of the dynasty.

programme.title: Old Fox [English Dub]
programme.desc: Set in the late 1980s, this family drama is about an 11-year-old boy who befriends his landlord, nicknamed Old Fox, and learns from him how to survive in a rapidly changing world as well as things his poor father would never be able to teach him.

programme.title: The Naked Kitchen [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Today is Mo-rae and Sang-in’s one-year wedding anniversary. Mo-rae goes to an art gallery to find a gift for Sang-in, where she meets a stranger and the two unexpectedly have sex. That night, Du-rae visits them to help Sang-in with his new business. To Mo-rae’s shock, he is the man from the gallery. He temporarily lives with the couple and a love triangle begins.

programme.title: Ransomed [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1987, a diplomat who had disappeared in Lebanon 20 months earlier sent a coded message announcing his survival. Min-joon, a diplomat in charge of Middle East affairs, volunteered for an unofficial operation to rescue his colleague, hoping to be posted to the United States if successful. After arriving at the airport, Min-joon got into the car of Pan-soo, a Korean taxi driver, to evade airport security who were trying to steal a ransom. He was chased by corrupt officials and gangs who were looking for money and didn't fully trust his only ally. Will Min-joon be able to complete the mission safely?

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Ana termina dando el sí y se casa con Cristóbal, a pesar que Guillermo rezaba para que no aceptara. En la celebración, Guillermo al ser uno de los testigos es quién realiza el brindis en el cual no pierde oportunidad para dejar ver que su primo jugo sucio y por eso es que logró casarse con Ana. Durante la fiesta Ana se entera de parte de Fernando, el padre de Cristóbal, que Guillermo la noche anterior había dejado a Yenny. Ante tal noticia sale en busca de Guillermo quién le confirma que eso es verdad. Ana se enoja con él y le pide que le explique cómo es que ella se está enterando tan tarde.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Armando se enfrenta a Finita tras percatarse de la persecución de la cual esta lo hizo víctima tras haberla informado de su noviazgo con Natalia | Finita se despoja de su orgullo para exigirle a Armando la verdad de sus sentimientos hacia ella al creerlo incapaz de haberla dejado de amar tras haber vivido 10 años de un tórrido y apasionado romance clandestino | que la llevaba a ser infiel en su matrimonio con Botero | Armando le fija su posición a Finita al dar por terminado su largo romance.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena se encuentra en la clínica con Gabriel y lo ve muy triste, le pregunta si está todo bien. Angie le prohíbe a Brenda que vaya a la oficina con su hijo cuando no tenga donde dejarlo, a pesar de tener la autorización de Gabriel. Ana Belén le dice a Efraín que lo vio junto a Valentina la noche anterior. Magdalena le cuenta a Gabriel que Agustín está haciendo todo lo posible para sacarle todo y dejarla en la calle. Ana Belén le pregunta a Efraín desde cuando son amantes con Valentina. Magdalena le dice a Gabriel que es mejor que estén separados porque cada uno tiene sus problemas, sus temas y que la vida los cruzo tarde para poder tener algo juntos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Elizabeth tiene una enfermedad grave y Cecilia busca curarla con hierbas para luego llevarla a Pedernales. Misael obtiene la custodia de Glorita, mientras Katiuska conspira con Renato contra Manuela. La tensión aumenta cuando Katiuska le roba a Candelaria una libreta con nombres de secuestradores y la quema, culpando a Hortensia y Benjamín para manipular a Ricardo. Finalmente, Cecilia se disculpa con Manuela tras un altercado con Jade, y Manuela decide mudarse a casa de Ricardo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Los malandros dan por muerto a Alejandro y vuelven a Caracas a cobrar. Alejandro sobrevive y es auxiliado por Severiano que cura su brazo con emplastos campesinos. Rosa convence a Eustoquio que el verdadero responsable de sus males es Erasto, no ella. Erasto engaña a Arminda prometiéndole su parte cuando aparezcan los papeles. Junior confiesa a Carlos que pierde la memoria. Consuelo se preocupa por la tardanza de Rosa. Rosa logra liberarse y toma un taxi a Caracas. Alejandro intuye que Rosalía lo traicionó al pensar quién sabía de su viaje. Rosa busca a Arminda exigiéndole la verdad sobre Eustoquio.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Alfredo Rosales muere en un accidente después de que Leoncio, mandado por Amada, cortara sus frenos. De esta manera, Luis Francisco se queda sin la información que el detective tenía para él sobre su hija. Alberta le dice a Benito que tendrán un hijo. Gina le pide ayuda a Braulio para conseguir un empleo, pero se siente decepcionada luego de que éste le sugiriera trabajar como empleada en un zoológico. Luego, ella amenaza a su madre con irse de su casa.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila spots a woman matching her mother's description. Anton, the hitman, is also there and armed, he goes to them. Torrealba orders his men to run to the women, grab Camila and take the woman away.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Rosa Blanco makes a call to Fausto and disturbs Ezequiel with threats against him, Octavia and her entire family. programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mother Isabel confirms to Camila part of the secrets she is hiding: Patricia and her sister-in-law Maria Amelia were the ones who denounced her mother. programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mother Isabel confesses to Camila but the girl knows she is still lying. Jeli, her little sister, suffers because of Fernando's irresponsibility, who impregnated her. Max announces to Marcelina and Astrid that he will soon marry Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Marina exige el divorcio. Alexei encuentra en casa de Varvara objetos de su antiguo hogar con Vera y descubre una impactante verdad.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es la mejor opción? ¿Un refugio familiar tranquilo o un romance apasionado? ¿Una esposa, con la que ha vivido durante décadas, o una joven amante? Después de pensarlo mucho, el protagonista de la película, Alexei, de 40 años, opta por rehacer su vida...

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei confiesa su infidelidad y deja a Vera. Se casa con Marina, pero pronto conoce a otra mujer, Varvara, con quien siente una conexión profunda.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei busca a Varvara y se enamora de ella. Marina descubre su romance y le envía fotos comprometedoras, desatando una crisis.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: «Enséñame a vivir» narra el reinado de terror de un asesino en serie que rompe la paz de una ciudad tranquila. El número de víctimas no deja de crecer, y el miedo se apodera de todos. La policía cree haber atrapado al culpable y lo encierra, dando el caso por cerrado. Pero entonces ocurre un nuevo asesinato. Un psiquiatra se ofrece a ayudar en la investigación y accede a reunirse con el sospechoso... quien le revela una verdad aterradora y mucho más peligrosa de lo que nadie imaginaba.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación destapa una serie de asesinatos con el mismo patrón, ocurridos hace 25 años. Su autor, Kosarev, cumple cadena perpetua y acaba de ver rechazada su libertad condicional por la comisión de Lavrov. Entre tensiones con Lavrov, Storozheva lo acompaña a visitar al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó el caso original... pero se niega a colaborar y actúa con sospecha. Al vigilarlo, descubren su vínculo con Gavrishin, el principal sospechoso de aquellos crímenes.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Puchkov se reúne con Kosarev en prisión. Este último cree que los nuevos asesinatos pueden probar su inocencia. Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita visita a Katya, la exesposa de Lavrov, para confirmar su coartada, y sale convencida de su inocencia: informa a su superior, Nikushin, que el verdadero objetivo del asesino podría ser Lavrov, y Katya la próxima víctima. Nikushin toma personalmente su seguridad. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor muerto en la infancia, y Lavrov empieza a sospechar de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien padece trastorno de identidad disociativo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: We took a look at Mercedes-Benz's first convertible model in their S-class. Also: for the Chevrolet Camaro's 50th anniversary in 2016 the brand released the sixth generation of their classic. And: a mountain cruise with the Corvette C7 convertible.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche GT3 RS bears a very special wing on its back. Also: the Mercedes-AMG GT S provides understatement and power at the same time. And: the even more uncompromising Radical RX C Turbo.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Nissan car brand emerged from the ruins of the Second World War and took on the then market leaders in Japan, GM and Ford. In the meantime, Nissan has risen to become a global player with a focus on practical and affordable cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: One of the most beautiful GT car models is the Maserati Gran Turismo S. With the 570GT, English sports car manufacturer McLaren introduced its first grand tourer. It was supposed to be the most comfortable but still very sporty McLaren.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG C43 was supposed to act as the entry-level model to the brand's cabriolet world. With the 718 Boxster, Porsche offers a convertible at a competitive price as well.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the Bentayga, Bentley introduced the first SUV in the brand's 100-year history. Range Rover took a different approach with the Evoque Cabriolet: they offered a convertible option for their SUV model. And: the Mercedes AMG GLE coupe.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Porsche's 911 Turbo S Cabriolet is a timelessly elegant all-rounder and nevertheless more of a cruiser than a sports vehicle. In direct contrast, the Rolls Royce Dawn provides luxury and elegance at a new level.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite car freaks from the Middle East to show off their souped-up vehicles on the "Walk" at Jumeirah Beach in Dubai. In this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro competes against a Mercedes SLS AMG.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: If you like souped-up and luxuriously equipped vehicles, Jumeirah Beach in Dubai is the place to be. There, the cars are judged and there is also something to win. This episode features a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Even though the Mercedes-AMG A45 Performmaster has just four cylinders, its sound is similar to its V8-colleagues by AMG. Also: the car tuning company MTM offers a similarly powerful alternative, based on an Audi: the RS3 R.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Functional transporters offer high payload and lots of storage space, and the new Volkswagen Crafter is no exception. How does it fare in comparison to the iconic Mercedes Sprinter? Also: the nearly indestructible and also iconic Unimog by Mercedes.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the Alfieri, Maserati in 2014 celebrated their anniversary with the introduction of a beautiful grand tourer. In remembrance and as part of the three-day celebration, Maserati organised a cruise from Bologna to Torino with some of their most iconic cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Mulsanne, Bentley's flagship car, provides luxury like in a first class hotel and elegance like an Armani suit. In addition: the Rolls-Royce Ghost. And: the high-tech coupe by Mercedes, the S 63 AMG with its V8 twin-turbo engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the i8, BMW tried to show the automotive world that they were ahead of their time. But why would anybody pay much more for a car that’s slower and less affordable than the brand's M4 and less spacious than the M5?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Porsche's 911 GTS closed the gap between the S and the GT3 in their sports car model range. Also: the Roding Roadster, a handcrafted lightweight sports car with technology by BMW at its core.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: On Put Your Car On TV, car fans from the Middle East can have their darlings rated in terms of speed, style and sound. Included this time: a Nova SS, a special Honda Accord and a car clad in crystals.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: The "Walk" at JBR in Dubai is the venue for our competition, as far as fancy and luxurious cars from all over the Middle East are concerned. This time, a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet are among the participants.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Chevrolet Corvette is the best-selling sports car in the world. It belongs to the USA like the Statue of Liberty, the Superbowl and John Wayne. Since its market launch the Corvette has developed into an automotive icon.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: 50 years of Porsche 911, 60 years of Chevrolet Corvette: two legends, two myths, two dream cars, and two philosophies. The Porsche 911 and the Chevrolet Corvette are the sports car icons in Europe and the USA.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In no other industry is marketing as important as in the automotive industry. Brands, models and advertising campaigns have been closely intertwined for decades. How has car advertising developed since the 1990s? Part 3 of 3.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Three extraordinarily sporty SUVs are the Porsche Macan Turbo, the Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and the Audi RSQ3. Each of these is able to easily cope with each season of the year and, in regards to performance, could be mistaken for a sports car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Panamera Turbo S is one of the most dynamic sedans in the world. In addition: the Jaguar XJR power sedan with a 550 hp V8 engine and Mercedes' extraordinary four-door coupe CLS 500.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Lexus was one of the pioneers when it comes to electric and hybrid cars. The brand's LS 600h, the BMW Active Hybrid 7 and the Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid are prime examples of this mixture between combustion and electric propulsion.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse in Austria is the ideal playground for the lightweight power packs Lotus Elise and Roding Roadster. Also: the elegant but still very powerful Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: With its extravagant design the Lexus NX200t definitely stands out. Infiniti, Nissan's luxury division, is more conservative in that regard. The QX30 features a classic Infiniti design with a curved bonnet. Also: the city SUV Mazda CX-3.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The S version of the Jaguar F-Pace is a tough competitor for Porsche Macan Turbo other rivals. Also: Audi launched its SQ7 as the most powerful diesel SUV on the market. And: the Bentley Bentayga, the first luxury class SUV in the world.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Audi is one of the most successful car manufacturers of the present day. The brand with the four rings stands for innovation, superior technology and unique design. Founded over 100 years ago, Audi is now a successful global player.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In 1932, the economic crisis led to the merger of the Horch, DKW, Audi and Wanderer brands under the name Auto Union, the second largest German car manufacturer at the time, which made motor sport history with the famous Silver Arrow racing cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Aston Martin's Vantage N430 model is a sports car that makes drivers and enthusiasts feel the heritage of British race cars. Also: a combination of elegance and power, the Bentley Continental GTC Speed with its W12 Twin Turbo engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2014, Mercedes-Benz presented their first Plug-in Hybrid, the S500. When it comes to Bentley, a V8 engine means down-sizing. We took a look at the brand's Flying Spur model with a smaller engine. And: the 6th generation Maserati Quattroporte.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: After its introduction the Audi RS6 was the benchmark when it came to extreme estate cars. Its performance was already very impressive, but according to the Audi tuners that still wasn't enough.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Do you want to feel like a racing driver without being limited to a race track? If so, the British manufacturer Radical is the right choice, as the company builds race cars with road approval. Their RXC is a powerful and agile racer.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Few manufacturers have been as active in the USA and Europe as early as Ford - and with success. While the Mustang thrilled American youth, the Capri turned the heads of Europeans.

programme.title: Car History
